formula_diagnostic.daily_return: simple split-adjusted close-to-close price return; no future bar and no dividend augmentation
formula_diagnostic.history: exactly 12 consecutive valid prior calendar months (a fail-closed local rule because the paper gives no monthly missing-history rule)
formula_diagnostic.liquidity_shock: -(ILLIQ_t - mean(ILLIQ_t-12..t-1)); no volatility standardization in the final RFS paper
formula_diagnostic.monthly_illiq: mean(valid daily terms) * 1e6; at least 15 valid daily returns
formula_diagnostic.warning: The structural score is diagnostic until the primary-paper return convention and local dividend basis are accepted.

limitations: The historical broad US_EQUITY bars have no complete PIT security-type taxonomy.
Historical spread and fully effective-dated tradability metadata are absent, so scanner reconstruction is conservative structural parity, not exact production snapshot identity.
The source manifest says split adjustment, but it does not independently encode the provider's price-volume adjustment algorithm.
The diagnostic uses split-adjusted close-to-close price returns and does not manufacture a dividend return from potentially mismatched historical cash-dividend/share bases.
Contemporaneous correlations diagnose mechanical overlap only and have no predictive or economic interpretation.

scanner_contract.historical_metadata_degradation: spread, complete tradability, sector, security type, and exchange are unavailable
scanner_contract.stage_a: top 300 by trailing 20 finite bars (including zero volume) median close*volume

split_audit.real_event_scope: Observed adjacent stored rows demonstrate price-basis continuity, not the provider's unadjusted-to-adjusted transformation algorithm.
